boundary_claims.claim: The productized research lab may surface advisory outputs and evidence for human review, but paper/shadow/live remain outside this milestone.
D2-006 promotion gates remain controlling before any research-to-shadow review.
fields_or_sections: D2-006 - Promotion gates are objective, numeric, and shared across all candidates

boundary_claims.claim: Shadow mode is the sole bridge from research backtester to paper runtime and requires a shadow window plus parity checks before Phase 3 eligibility.
fields_or_sections: D2-007 - Shadow mode is the sole bridge from research backtester to paper runtime

boundary_claims.claim: Agents and lab automation cannot approve gates, touch live systems, change risk parameters, or create execution authority.
fields_or_sections: D2-011 - Agent roster and autonomy levels

boundary_claims.claim: REC-5 exact-segment evidence requires at least three reconciliations per candidate/outcome/pipeline/expectation-source segment before segment-level inference.
Approval/readiness criteria may inform human review but cannot create automatic transition, promotion, readiness, paper/live, or runtime authority.
Scope 6 approval and evidence records document human decisions and required evidence, but do not implement transitions or authorize runtime contact.
fields_or_sections: What this locking decision does not authorize

boundary_claims.claim: A future canonical crossing requires explicit human approval, source-content review, hash validation, denominator preservation, validator/integrity preflight, append-only write semantics, post-write validation, and audit reporting.
Candidate lifecycle records are evidence indexes and human-review workflow records only, not execution authority.
Walk-forward/OOS and robustness outputs are review inputs only; pass/fail/blocked/advisory statuses cannot approve candidates or create readiness.
Future paper/shadow chassis or paper-bot scaffolding remains design-only unless separately authorized and cannot contact broker/exchange/order/provider paths or protected runtime paths.
Permanent human gates remain human-controlled for hypothesis approval, go/no-go decisions, shadow promotion, live promotion, risk changes, kill decisions, and novel strategy-family introduction.
